sloka: कच्चिन्न व्यथितो रामः कच्चिन्न परितप्यते ।उत्तराणि च कार्याणि कुरुते पुरुषोत्तमः ।। ५.३६.१५।।।।
transliteration: kaccinna vyathito rāmaḥ kaccinna paritapyate ।uttarāṇi ca kāryāṇi kurute puruṣottamaḥ ।। 5.36.15।।।।

translations.english: "Is Rama the greatest among men not depressed? Does he not feel helpless? He is (perhaps) taking necessary steps (for my recovery).
